tunnelSystems.name: Continuous Pilot R&D Freeze-Drying Tunnel (150 kg/h, 0.08 mbar, -55°C Condenser, 12 Glycol Zones, 316L SS)
tunnelSystems.classification: Pilot Food & Bio-Nutraceutical Process Authority Unit (FDA 21 CFR § 111 / ASME VIII)
tunnelSystems.description: Continuous pilot-scale conveyor freeze-drying tunnel designed for recipe qualification, collapse temperature boundary mapping, and sublimation rate kinetics under steady-state continuous vacuum flow.

tunnelSystems.name: Industrial High-Capacity Continuous Food Conveyor Lyophilizer (1,200 kg/h, 0.12 mbar, -65°C Dual Alternating Condensers, 48 Zones)
tunnelSystems.classification: High-Throughput Commercial Lyophilization Plant (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / 3-A Sanitary / EHEDG)
tunnelSystems.description: Heavy-duty continuous multi-stage freeze-drying tunnel with automated vacuum load-lock chambers, dual automated alternating ice condenser coils with hot-gas defrost, and high-efficiency closed-loop glycol heat transfer.

tunnelSystems.name: Ultra-Aseptic Continuous Probiotic & Bio-Peptide Cryo-Tunnel (350 kg/h, 0.05 mbar, -80°C LN2 Condenser, ISO 5 Airlocks)
tunnelSystems.classification: Aseptic Biological & Starter Culture Preservation Line (ISO 13408-3 / cGMP / ASME BPE)
tunnelSystems.description: Ultra-clean continuous lyophilization tunnel engineered for living probiotic starter cultures, pharmaceutical nutraceuticals, and enzymes requiring sub-ambient desorption cycles and zero cross-contamination risks.

tunnelSystems.name: Compromised / Choked Tunnel (Excessive Ice Cake, Choking Vapor Duct, Unbalanced Glycol Platens & Seal Leaks)
tunnelSystems.classification: Hazardous Operating Condition (Melt-Back Collapse, Vacuum Loss & High Water Activity)
tunnelSystems.description: Severely compromised freeze-drying tunnel suffering from sonic vapor duct throttling, excessive insulating ice cake on condenser coils, glycol channel flow maldistribution, and vacuum lock air in-leakage.

targetProducts.name: Probiotic Starter Cultures & Active Lactic Acid Bacteria (Lactobacillus / Bifidobacterium)
targetProducts.thermalSensitivity: Ultra-High (Viability drops exponentially if shelf T > 32°C during desorption)
targetProducts.description: Living bacterial cultures for yogurt, cheese, and dietary supplements. Maintaining ice interface temperature strictly below -29°C prevents glassy matrix collapse and preserves high colony-forming unit (CFU) viability.

targetProducts.name: IQF Strawberries & Whole Berry Fruits (High Fructose / Organic Acid Matrix)
targetProducts.thermalSensitivity: High (Sugar softening and dark caramelization above 48°C shelf temperature)
targetProducts.description: Premium whole berries requiring rapid sublimative vapor evacuation. High sugar and organic acid contents create a low collapse threshold (-21°C); exceeding it causes sticky syrup bleeding and structural shrinkage.

targetProducts.name: Aseptic Cooked Shredded Poultry Meat & Instant Meal Rations (High Protein Fibrils)
targetProducts.thermalSensitivity: Moderate (Protein cross-linking and tough rehydration if desorption T > 60°C)
targetProducts.description: Fibrous meat protein matrices provide wide open pore structures for rapid sublimation flux. Resilient collapse temperature (-15.5°C) enables higher shelf temperature ramps while maintaining instantaneous hot-water rehydration.

targetProducts.name: Heat-Sensitive Marine Enzymes & Bio-Active Peptides (Deep-Sea Collagen)
targetProducts.thermalSensitivity: Ultra-High (Enzyme catalytic activity denatures rapidly if ice front warms above -26°C)
targetProducts.description: High-value marine enzymatic extracts and functional peptides. Requires stringent sublimation temperature control and deep secondary vacuum desorption (<0.06 mbar) to reach ultra-low water activity (<0.15).

glycolThermalFluids.name: Inhibited Food-Grade Propylene Glycol 50/50 Water Mix (USP / NSF HT1)
glycolThermalFluids.description: Standard non-toxic food-safe secondary refrigerant and heating fluid used across industrial food freeze-drying conveyor shelves.

glycolThermalFluids.name: Synthetic Polydimethylsiloxane Thermal Fluid (Syltherm XLT / Dowtherm)
glycolThermalFluids.description: Ultra-low viscosity synthetic heat transfer fluid ideal for high-speed pharmaceutical and cryogenic freeze-drying platen circulation down to -100°C.
